title: Nissan Sentra, Versa, Versa Note, Altima, Juke CVT: judder, hesitation, flare; 84-month / 84k CVT warranty extension
summary: Nissan's May 2020 CVT warranty extension (from class action settlements) takes CVT coverage on 2012-17 Versa, 2014-17 Versa Note, 2013-17 Sentra, 2013-16 Altima and 2013-17 Juke from 60 months / 60,000 miles to 84 / 84,000, including rental during repairs. For the Sentra, NTB19-075a lays out the judder diagnosis starting from a specific DTC list.

specs.name: Warranty extension
specs.value: From 60 months / 60,000 miles to 84 months / 84,000 miles, whichever first; activated May 11, 2020

specs.name: Extension covers
specs.value: CVT assembly and internals, gaskets and seals, control valve body, torque converter, cooler kit (if applicable), TCM reprogramming, and a rental while CVT repairs are done

specs.name: Sentra judder bulletin applies to
specs.value: 2013-2017 Sentra (B17), MRA8DE non-turbo engine, CVT RE0F11A

specs.name: Sentra judder DTCs (start of the diagnosis)
Powertrain Call Center (pre-approval for CVT replacement over DCAL)

steps.text: Check the VIN for the extension; owners who opted out of the class settlements aren't covered, so it's per-VIN.
Sentra complaint of judder (shake, shudder, bumps, vibration), hesitation, lack of power or RPM flare: check for the listed DTCs. None stored: NTB19-075a doesn't apply; use ASIST.

If codes are stored, confirm the TCM part number and reprogram the TCM per NTB18-058 if a newer calibration is available, then follow NTB19-075a's repair overview (noise check in Park/Neutral vs. Drive/Reverse, CVT pan debris inspection, and the CVT replacement approval steps).
Valve bodies and belt-and-pulley kits don't need pre-authorization under warranty; a full CVT over the dealer's authorization limit does.

body: NTB19-075a is 147 pages; only its applicability, DTC list and the opening decisions of its repair overview are summarized here. Work from the bulletin itself for the full flow.
